{{Quote|The Empire will come in earnest, now. This doesn't fit Malora's pattern&hellip;she never bothered to disable enemy communications during her siege of Nantoon&hellip;|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
The '''siege of Nantoon''' was a battle that took place<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> some time before [[3628 BBY]]<ref name="TORDate">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> on [[Nantoon/Legends|Nantoon]]. During the siege, the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] were led by led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Malora]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siege of Nantoon was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically the<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> [[2018]]<ref name="JUS Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20181211-0|text='Jedi Under Siege' Update – Play Now!}}</ref> 5.10 ''Jedi Under Siege'' update to the [[2016]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. The siege of Nantoon is only mentioned if the player's character, known [[in-universe]] as the [[Alliance Commander]], is among the character classes originally aligned with the Republic.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
